Manage glossary documents.

Usage: papyrus glossary [OPTIONS] [COMMAND]

Commands:
  create   Create a glossary term
  list     List glossary terms
  view     View a glossary term
  edit     Edit a glossary term
  archive  Archive a glossary term
  delete   Delete a glossary term
  status   Set glossary term status
  help     Print this message or the help of the given subcommand(s)

Options:
      --json           Emit stable, machine-readable JSON.
      --dir <path>     Project directory. Default: the current working directory.
      --config <file>  Configuration file. Default: papyrus.config.yml in the project directory.
      --no-color       Disable ANSI color output.
  -h, --help           Print help
